objective: Make src/server.ts testable and prove with tests that the dashboard stays password-protected (#5). Export `buildApp({ password, snapshotsDir, root? })` returning a ready (not listening) Fastify instance; keep `listen()` only in an entry path that runs when the file is executed directly (`pnpm start` = `tsx src/server.ts`, also `pnpm dev`). Add test/page/server.test.ts using `app.inject()` (no real port, no network) covering every Done-when case. contract:
Issue #5 Done when (verbatim):
- Tests prove: `/`, `/?date=…`, `/style.css`, `/tokens.css`, `/logo.svg` return 401 without the password and 200 with it; `/healthz` returns 200 without it (O-2, P-6)
- A wrong password is refused; an unknown `?date=` falls back to the newest snapshot instead of reading other files
- The tests run without opening a real port or touching the network

Facts measured at base cf20405:
- src/server.ts (inlined below) reads DASHBOARD_PASSWORD at module scope, registers @fastify/basic-auth, serves /healthz open, three static assets from public/, and `/` from snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json, then calls app.listen() at import time with top-level await. So it cannot be imported by a test today.
- package.json scripts: start = `tsx src/server.ts`, dev = `tsx watch src/server.ts`. render.yaml startCommand: `pnpm start`; DASHBOARD_PASSWORD is `sync: false` (set in the Render dashboard). Render sets env RENDER=true on its services.
- With no password the server currently serves openly and logs a warning (local dev). Keep that for local dev; only the Render/production case fails closed.
- Tests: vitest includes test/**/*.test.ts; unstubGlobals true. Gate at base: 4 files, 35 tests passed.
- Snapshot fixture: test/fixtures/snapshot.json (coordinator-owned: read it, never edit it). For a snapshotsDir in tests, create a temp dir (node:fs mkdtemp under os.tmpdir()) and copy the fixture in as e.g. 2026-11-16.json and 2026-11-15.json (set each copy's date field to match). Never write under snapshots/.
- An unknown ?date= must never be used to build a path: the current code only reads a date found in the readdir list; keep that and test it with e.g. `?date=../package` and `?date=2099-01-01` (both fall back to the newest, status 200).

Decision: the entry guard. Compare `import.meta.url` with `pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href` (or an equivalent that works under tsx). Verify by actually running `DASHBOARD_PASSWORD=x PORT=3199 pnpm start` in the background, curl http://localhost:3199/healthz (expect 200), then kill it; and run `RENDER=true pnpm start` with DASHBOARD_PASSWORD unset and confirm it exits non-zero. Report both outputs in the return.
